conditions: Two inertial frames at constant relative speed 0<=v<c; both events occur at the same spatial point of the clock rest frame, with future-directed elapsed intervals. Gamma is the Lorentz factor.

symbols.\\Delta t: Coordinate time interval in observing frame
symbols.\\Delta\\tau: Proper time interval on moving clock

evidence: For two events on a clock's inertial worldline, delta x has magnitude v delta t in the observing frame. The invariant interval gives delta tau^2=delta t^2-(v delta t)^2/c^2. With future-directed positive intervals and v<c, take the positive root and rearrange to delta t=gamma delta tau.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-3/pages/5-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
